10110010.t: Hideout
One leisurely day...
No work today... and those freeloaders are out, so...
...Ahem...
[Exclusive! Handover of Panoticon Management Complete... Direction Leans Toward Internal Promotion]
Already? Man, that Head Maid really knows how to get things done.
[In-Depth Study: The Impact of the Vermont Ethics Committee's Implementation of the Chase Code on Adult Films]
Is that what Valentina was so mad about... Guess I should buy her a drink next time.
[Next article... Editor-in-chief isn't doing any work, let's see if this gets reviewed]
...? What's this?
[Feature Article: Upcoming Lingerie Fashion Show this Winter... A Huge Roster of Famous Designers Joining! Model Auditions Underway.]
A lingerie show, huh... I wonder if it's the same as that [Luxury Lingerie] from last time. And with famous designers involved, too.
This is... pretty revealing... Ahem... At this rate, they're practically naked.
Who's the saint who made such magnificent clothes... Let's see here... Er... mina...?
Trick or treat! Are you enjoying the festival, my friend!?
?! Wh-What the!?
What do you mean, what is it? It's Halloween, Hal-lo-ween!
The day the boundaries blur. And the festival to commemorate it.
Exactly! With the festival in full swing, what are you doing all alone in this corner of your room... wait...
Ahem... Well, looks like you had your own little festival going on in here. Mm-hmm.
...Full of vigor. Proof that you're healthy.
Get out, you two!!!
...So. What do you want?
Ahaha! Well, you see, the Halloween festival has begun in the Quartet.
Do you know what Halloween is?
You think I wouldn't know?
...What is it, then?
...Uh... Well...
Isn't it a festival where you dress up in costumes and play naughty pranks?
Ahahaha! Exactly! Now that's my friend!
Hey, what is it then?! Go grab anyone outside and ask them, most of them would say the exact same thing!
And why barge in out of nowhere just to host a quiz show?! I'm the one whose peaceful break got ruined here.
...Sorry about that.
Haha, fair enough. But don't be so angry, my friend.
Because this is going to be good news for you, too...
...Oho? What, you've got a job for me?
Just so you know, I don't lift a finger unless the pay is good.
What? Payment? How cold of you, my friend, considering what we are to each other!
And what exactly are we to each other?
...What are you to each other?
Hmm...
People who exchanged something precious?
Something... precious...
Wait, that's a misunderstanding.
You didn't give me anything.
...Why?
I told you, I didn't give her anything in the first place! And do you even know what she's talking about?
What? Don't tell me you forgot? *Sob*... Does that mean the promise you made to me was just a fleeting fling?
No, I mean, what promise was it in the first place?! Wait, don't tell me...
Is it that? The promise to get drinks we made a while back?!
Haha! You finally remembered, my friend!
Then just say that! You almost caused a huge misunderstanding! Her eyes were already looking weird, you know!
...A promise to drink.
Yeah! It was just a promise to drink together. I happened to get some good whiskey, so I traded it for some of Dan Xi's traditional liquor.
I see...
Yeah, so...
You didn't make one with me.
Why on earth would I make a drinking promise with you?! You can't even hold your liquor in the first place.
But...
I want to drink with <:player>, too.
Geez, alright, alright. If we drink next time, come along with Dan Xi.
Anyway, just get to the point already. What's the deal with Halloween?
Well... my friend. Do you know what our Fairwinds Association actually does?
A gathering of slackers living the poetic life?
Indeed, a gathering of slackers drifting like wind and clouds, living the poetic... Wait, what!? M-My friend, is that really what you've thought of me this whole time?
How rude. Maybe Dan Xi is, but not me.
Wait, Kouchou! That's not true for me either!? I am very much an active martial artist working for the Fairwinds Association, you know?!
Yeah, right. Just the other day, I saw you passed out drunk in an alley. If I hadn't found you, you'd have ended up straight in the donut house.
A-Ahem! I-I am grateful for that, of course.
At any rate, the Fairwinds Association's primary duty is managing the festivals held every day in the Quartet...
What's that? Sounds like an easy gig where you just slack off and have fun.
Indeed. Partying and slacking off day after day without ever getting tired of it...
Wait, my friend! Cease this misunderstanding and slander at once!
I couldn't help it, your reactions are just too priceless.
!?  Good grief, you really are hopeless.
...I'll continue explaining.
<:player>, do you know why the Orchid Clan hosts a festival every day?
Hmm... I feel like I've heard about it somewhere...
Could it be because they just love festivals that much? Festival maniacs?
*Sigh.*
!? What? Did Kouchou just sigh at me!?
Ahaha! That's why you need to give a serious answer, my friend!
Ugh... Then... is it to make money? Because the Quartet is secretly broke?
...The Orchid Clan hosting the festival has the most wealth among the four clans.
Then what the heck is it?!
The Quartet fights to prevent the erosion of the Corrupting Power.
And in order to repel the Corrupting Power, we need the purifying energy that people possess.
That's why we hold festivals to keep everyone joyful.
Corrupting Power?
Indeed. It is a power born from "things" that should never exist.
If you are eroded by that power, you gradually change... until you become "the same" as them.
And fighting to ensure that never happens is the duty of the Quartet's four clans.
Ooh... That actually sounds surprisingly legit...
So you guys weren't just useless slackers after all?
Regardless, we fight to protect the festival from such vile corruption.
And the reason we came to find you...
Is because you need my help, right?
That's my friend. Quick on the uptake. Looks like there's no need for further explanation!
Just as you said, our Fairwinds Association needs your help in safeguarding the festival.
Well, I get that. But here's the thing...
You know I don't work for free, right?
Of course, I know that all too well. If you help us...
...Can't you just help us?
Ugh... You're playing that card?
<:player> didn't drink with me.
...Unfair.
I would grant <:player>'s request without asking for anything in return, though.
...Anything?
Yeah.
...Anything.
Ah, if you put it like that, I can't refuse...
Alright, let's see what this is all about first. I'll think of something else for payment later...

10110020.t: Sky Lantern Street
...The Corrupting Power has grown stronger.
Hmph, so it seems.
Wh-What are those things?
Didn't I tell you? They are being eroded.
To think they're even roaming inside the city... What is the guard doing...
Those are Aberrant Spirits... Remnants that seeped from the Rift.
If left alone, they'll cause harm.
Harm? What kind of harm are you talking about?
Strange, my shoulders feel unusually heavy today...
That's because you've got those pointlessly huge things hanging off your chest.
What? Just admit you're jealous.
I'm perfectly fine as I am, thank you very much!
Sure you are. Even though you secretly tried on my chest wraps last night!
Ack?! Y-You were awake...?! How sneaky...!
Heheh! So what if I was?
H-Hey? Are you really mad?
...Give it.
Huh? Wh-What did you say?
Give it... to me... Your... precious... thing...
Eeek?! W-Wait a minute...?! I was just kidding earlier, okay?! Besides, I can't give you this!
I strictly want to stay friends with you...!
Fri... end...?
Yes, friends!
Fri...end...
Friends... delicious...
Eek!?
Give me... more... Your feelings... Your... [■■■]...
N-Not theeeere—!?
Whoa, this is that kind of festival? You should've told me sooner.
No, it's not.
Phew, to think the festival streets have already been eroded this much.
I'll cleanse the corruption for now.
Huh?! Wh-What did I just do...
Haa... Haa...♡
I only wanted to stay friends...! That was supposed to be enough...! Waaahhh!!
Ah! W-Wait...! Honestly, it felt kind of good...!
...So when people get possessed by those Aberrant Spirits or whatever, does their libido just suddenly explode or something?
Haha, close, but not quite. They feed on "emotions," "drives," "memories," and "thoughts." In other words, every mental element that forms a person's Origin.
They eat... the mind? That sounds pretty creepy.
An Aberrant Spirit that has consumed enough mental energy can materialize. And when that happens, other problems arise...
Regardless, a minor Aberrant Spirit clinging to someone briefly like that won't cause serious harm, so there's no need to worry too much.
Though it might become difficult to suppress emotions or drives for a little while...
Ugh, this place is already full of people who've completely lost control of that stuff...
By the way, do you know why they possess people or act like that?
Yeah. Because where they exist is beyond the boundary.
They endlessly yearn for "something" that cannot be felt or obtained there.
Which is why they cross over to this side?
Correct! That's my friend for you. Teach you one thing and you grasp two!
Hey, I can't breathe, let go! Not that I mind, but! When you hug me with your strength... *Cough!*
Dan Xi, let go. Any more than that and <:player> will turn into an Aberrant Spirit.
Oops! R-Right. Well, though it might be fun if my friend became an Aberrant Spirit.
Whew... I almost died by boobs.
Death by boobs...
If only mine were a little bigger.
Hey, what are you envying that for? Are you trying to kill me too?
Yours are plenty pretty right now, so don't worry about it.
...Hmph.
Anyway, I get that those Aberrant Spirits are yearning for all sorts of things, and I get that the festival is turning into a mess because of them, but...
So, what's the solution? Do we just exorcise every last one of them like Kouchou did earlier?
Well, about that...
We will have to suspend the Halloween festival and exterminate the Aberrant Spirits.
Out of nowhere?!
I hear the origin of Halloween is a festival honoring the dead.
This is the time when the boundary between the living and the dead is at its weakest...
To hold such a festival at a time like this... What on earth is the Orchid Clan thinking?
Is it not common knowledge that the Orchid Clan holds festivals all year round?
And what were they thinking? Why, naturally...
They were thinking of partying!
!? Saying that with such confidence...?!
...Well, very well. Lady Dan Xi's brazen insolence was already factored into my plans.
Oho...? Which means...
Yes. The Fairwinds Association's duty is to "protect the festival"...
Therefore, I anticipated that you would not back down even in a situation like this.
In that case, the Umbral Watch will simply carry out the Umbral Watch's duty.
You... Yes, you would certainly be capable of handling the Aberrant Spirits.
A powerhouse of the Moonshadow Wardens, fufu. This is getting exciting.
...It has been some time, <:player>. Have you been keeping well?
My, do you not even see me standing here?
<:player>. Just as Kage said, the festival has been overrun by Aberrant Spirits and is in a perilous state.
For your own safety, please leave this matter to me.
That's not happening.
<:player> promised to protect the festival with us.
...Outsiders should stay out of this.
A-A promise...? Outsiders...?
To call me an outsider is quite unacceptable.
Though of modest ability, I belong to the Moonshadow Wardens, who purge Aberrant Spirits.
In circumstances like these, where Aberrant Spirits run rampant, I cannot simply stand by and watch.
...What will you do, <:player>?
<:player>... With whom shall you side?
!? Why put this on me all of a sudden!?

10110030.t:
Haha, what a dilemma you find yourself in, my friend.
This is why you should have behaved yourself better on normal days, shouldn't you?

Blaming me now?
Dammit. What did I even do wrong?

<:player>...
I still remember the time I spent with you.
Back then... <:player>, you caressed my most intimate places and said...
That you looked forward to a stronger me... one who had come to know passion...
I have not forgotten that promise for even a single moment.
...I have a promise, too.
While roughly fondling my thighs... you said you'd let me stay by your side.
Do you remember... that promise?
(Guh...! Which choice am I supposed to make...!?)
Choose Chise

Fufu...
I had faith in your choice, <:player>.
Now then, let us go together.

...You're leaving?
Even though you promised me...

That power is...?
...I see. Is it the effect of the boundary collapsing?

It is certainly no ordinary power, but...
even if only for your sake, <:player>, I shall not back down.
Choose Kouchou
Yeah. It's the natural choice.
So you two should take your leave now.

...How could this be...
<:player>... What of the promise you made to me...
Hmph. Our promise came first...
No, mine came first...!
Choose Dan Xi
I... choose this one!
Huh? Me?

What, got a problem, you flat-chested runts?
Well, not that either of you are actually small, but...
Either way, I'm warning you: if you two fight, I won't look at either of your faces for a month.

...You can't do that.
And... they're not small.

...That would be quite distressing...
And mine are not that small either...
Shut it! If you're that frustrated about it, go make yours as big as these first!

Anyway!
Stop fighting over dumb things and let's get this job done already!

Weren't both of your sides trying to solve the Aberrant Spirit problem anyway?
You're just split on whether to cancel the festival or not.

That is true. For the Umbral Watch and Moonshadow Wardens, whose priority is purging Aberrant Spirits and protecting the Quartet, it is a natural choice.
It's not as if I don't understand where they're coming from...

We also understand the Fairwinds Association's intent to protect the festival.
As well as that being a means to suppress the Corrupting Power...

But we cannot allow Aberrant Spirits to run rampant in the Quartet either.
Especially for the Chrysanthemum Clan, whose duty is to purge them.

Then we have our answer.
As long as we purge the Aberrant Spirits first, the method doesn't really matter, right?
Of course. However, purifying them one by one like this will never keep up with the speed at which they spawn.

Mmm... That cannot be denied.
Even with Kouchou and myself stepping up, the Aberrant Spirits roaming the festival far outnumber us.

But we have an ace up our sleeve.
Namely...

If you say it's me, you'll be playing fighting games with me for three straight days.
And I'll teabag you every time I win.

!? M-My friend.
That's... Haa...♡

Looks like I guessed right.
No wonder you accepted my conditions so easily...

He-Hehe. Is that not your greatest strength?
I have faith that my friend can find a breakthrough even in a situation like this.

Tch.
Fine, whatever.
Kage, does the method you mentioned have to be carried out right this second?

That is not necessarily the case.
However, the longer we delay, the worse the erosion will become.

Right now, it may only corrupt the festival, but if left alone...
it will spread across the entire Quartet.
If that happens, the tragedy of the past will repeat itself.
Hmm...
I won't let that happen.

The boundary has thinned, but it's still functioning.
Because I've been protecting it all this time.

The Aberrant Spirits appearing now...
are special. They're drawn to something.

Drawn to something...?
What is it?

...I don't know.
I haven't figured that out yet.
Ugh...
Well, isn't that why you came to me?
Anyway, Kage, if you aren't putting your plan into action right away, why not give us a little time?
If we fail, we'll let you know right away.
If that's the case...
If we succeed, the aberrant spirits will retreat, so that's great. And even if we fail, you can just come up with a backup plan for when things go wrong.
Isn't that what you do best?

Heh... Just as expected, <:player>.
You manage to surprise me once again.

Very well. If it's your plan...
Even if I'm not fully convinced, I can trust it.
Is that fine with you too, Chise?
...If that is your wish, <:player>...
Hyah...?!

Don't look so disappointed.
I'll get rid of the aberrant spirits quickly and come play with you, too.

Keep yourself warm until then.
Got it?

Haa... Understood.
I shall... await that moment♡

All right, then... Now let's go sort this out—
Wait, what?
Once again, you didn't do it to me.

!?
Ah, fine, all I have to do is do it to you too, right?

Ngh...!
Haah...

She's being pretty bold today, isn't she?
Did something happen?

Who knows?
Hehe, could it be she simply missed your touch, my friend?

More importantly, that's my friend for you.
Things could have gotten out of hand, but you resolved it nicely.
We were on the verge of fighting amongst ourselves before even dealing with the aberrant spirits, were we not?

Tch...
As if you didn't call me here expecting that very thing.

Anyway, lead the way.
After all, if we can't solve the problem, you'll just make your move anyway, won't you, Kage?
Right, then let us have a look around the festival streets.

10110040.t: ...Phew.
Haha, there really is no end to them!

Hey, they really just keep coming!
Shouldn't we just do what Kage said?

Hmm? Giving up already?
That is not like you, my friend.
Sheesh, don't just stand there talking—say something actually helpful!
I mean... what was it again? If there's something drawing the aberrant spirits here, shouldn't we be looking for that?

Perhaps.
But how do you propose we blindly search for it across the vast expanse of Sky Lantern Street?
It would truly be like looking for a needle in a haystack, would it not?
Kh...
...I'm nearing my limit.

I could keep this up all day, but...
with so many aberrant spirits, some are bound to slip through.
On top of that, the corrupting power left behind by the aberrant spirits is drawing even more of them in...

Well now, it's quite a festival over here too, isn't it?
*Hic!*

But what's the point of pouring water into a cracked jar?
Hehe...

Hiyori?!
You came to help us?

Nope. I just came to drink.
...*Hic!*
Hehe, care for a drink too if you'd like?

Damn it, of course that's why...
Can't you see we're dealing with aberrant spirits here? This is no time to be drinking!

Ehehe, don't glare at me like that.
It's a festival, shouldn't you be enjoying it?

Besides, I haven't even been awake for that long today!
This is my very first bottle, my first bottle!
That just means you're slightly less drunk than usual!!
Don't sweat the small stuff!

Wait, what about you over there...?
Hmm...
...What?

No, I mean... you.
You're harboring something pretty outrageous, aren't you?
Bwahaha! I've seen plenty of crazy folks, but it's been a long time since I saw someone as out of their mind as you!

Man! How on earth do you live holding that in?
If it were me, I would've jumped him on the spot! Ehehe, humans really are a riot!
And as for you...
Heh...
You're strong, aren't you?

The First Sword of the Four Seasons, Hiyori, was it...?
This is my first time meeting you in person.
Judging by the ominous aura emanating from you, you are certainly no ordinary martial artist.

Oho...!
You can actually sense that?

Hahaha! Now this is an unexpected bonus!
Festivals really are the best!!

Ah, what a shame.
If only the conditions were right...
It would've been great to have a match right here.

Fufu, I would be happy to spar anytime you wish.
However, right now... I have other matters to attend to.

Ehehe, fair enough, nothing we can do about that!
Good luck with your hard work!
Ah, come to think of it, do you enjoy festivals?

Festivals?
You bet I do!
Delicious food, delicious booze, and so much to see!

Fufu, is that so?
In that case, you might find yourself in quite a predicament.
Because before long, the festival might be shut down.
W-What?!

That can't happen!
I haven't even finished my first bottle yet!!!
I haven't even claimed the free booze they give members of The Four Seasons yet!!
...If we can't stop the aberrant spirits from running rampant like this, that may very well happen.

Well, that's a huge problem, isn't it?!
Ngh... guess I have no choice.
Oh, you're gonna help us?
Hah, do you really still know me so little?
Do you really think I'd draw my sword for something like this?
Of course not, you drunkard.

Kyahaha! Yeah, that's right!
You hit the nail right on the head.
Drawing my blade over something like this wouldn't even count as entertainment!
Still, it would be a real problem if the festival got shut down like this.
So... how about I give you a little tip?
Hey, shrine maiden over there. Do you know how to set up a barrier?
...A basic one, yes.

Ehehe, that's all you need.
Just make sure the aberrant spirits can't escape.

You guys have been focusing only on taking down the aberrant spirits.
That'll never work.
The key thing is keeping the 'corruption' from spreading, got it?
In other words, erect a barrier so the aberrant spirits can't slip away to other places... like this!

Hehe, no need to draw a sword against small fry like this!
Bare-handed martial arts are more than enough.
Anyway, if you do it like this, the aberrant spirits will—

Ah, geez, is it still too early for this after all...?
Hmm...

?
What is?
Yahaha! Never mind, just something on my mind.

Anyway! Fundamentally, these things vanish if they can't siphon mental energy.
Well, even if they do, they just return to the 'other side'!
So... as long as we put up a barrier and keep them from spreading, they'll disappear on their own?

Bingo! Exactly!
That way, the corrupting power won't leak out, and the erosion won't spread either!
Hmm... But who's gonna do it?

Huh?
You guys, obviously...
If Kouchou sets up the barrier, Dan Xi has to deal with the aberrant spirits all by herself, doesn't she?

Mmm... Well, figure it out yourself, Mr. Fixer!
Bye now!
Hey, hey! Are you really just walking away?!
Well, I appreciate that you told us the method, but...
Kouchou, will it really work if we do what she said?
...Yes.
Aberrant spirits gradually exhaust themselves and dissipate over time, leaving corrupting power in their wake.
If we deploy a barrier, we should be able to prevent the aberrant spirits from escaping and stop the corrupting power from eroding the area.
However, if we do that, Dan Xi will have to face the aberrant spirits alone.
Hmm... It is not impossible, but I honestly do not think I could hold them all off.
Dealing with numbers like this will take quite a bit of time.
So we're short on manpower?

...At least two.
If I had people to maintain the barrier with me.
Really? Does it matter who?

No. I'll cast the ritual myself.
It's enough if they just lend me their strength by my side.

All right.
In that case...

?
Who are you calling?

Someone who's probably slacking off right now came to mind.
Since it's come to this, might as well put her to work.

Hello? Ah, is this the Hundred Schools of Thought?
I'd like to report one of your teachers...

10110050.t: Ferry Landing
Man, spending a lazy day by the Ferry Landing really is the best!
No noisy naggers today, and no research papers to turn in either!
Now then, time to do some relaxing fishing...
Hey! How many times did I call you before you picked up?!
Ah! <:player>, hello, hello! ☆
"Hello" my foot! Why is getting you to answer the phone on extreme difficulty mode?!
Huh? You called? ...Whoa, that's a ton of missed calls!
Yeah! What on earth were you even doing?
Me? <bouten>Slacking off</bouten>, of course! Doing some fishing while I'm at it!
Well, I came all the way out here figuring that's what you were up to anyway.
You know me so well!
Too bad, though. There's something I need you to do.
W-What?! I only just got here to relax!
Oho, is that so? Did you finish all your work?
...Y-Yeah. P-Probably...?
What about turning in your research paper?
Grading your students?
...Hehe.
Ah, is this the Hundred Schools of Thought? I found a delinquent teacher over here...

Waaah—! Wait, wait! W-What do you want?! My next paper?! Research collaboration?! Second authorship?!
Or... d-don't tell me!
That's right, <bouten>your body</bouten>—!
...is what you thought, but nope.
I-Is that so? Ahaha!
All right, explain it to her.

The festival has begun to be overrun by aberrant spirits.
It is difficult to resolve with the Fairwinds Association's strength alone.

I-Is that so...? But I belong to the Hundred Schools of Thought, so I won't be much help in a fight.
Wouldn't it be better to ask the Moonshadow Wardens...?

If we could, we would have done that already.
I contacted them earlier, but aberrant spirits showed up on the outskirts, so they're dealing with that first.
Right now, we'd literally take help from a cat.
Ah, then why don't you go ask a cat...
That cat is you.

Agh, there's really no way out of this!
I just want to rest, too!!
Look who's talking, you lazy slacker who cuts corners all the time anyway.
If you're gonna keep whining, why don't you turn into an actual cat or something...
...Will you let me off the hook if I act like a cat?

Not a chance.
Give up and get to work, you slave to society!!

Just as <:player> said, we desperately need every bit of help we can get.
Won't you consider it?
Once this is all sorted out, I will treat you to some fine wine.

... Mmm... If it's Dan Xi asking...
B-But... aberrant spirits...?
Are you scared?

S-S-S-Scared?! What do you mean, scared?! I'm not scared at all, okay?!
I am a scholar of the Hundred Schools of Thought, a master of theory, logic, philosophy, and thought!
There's no way I'd be scared of some illogical, unscientific, unverifiable, unreproducible supernatural phenomenon?!

It's already being proven and reproduced right in front of us...
Good grief.

Well then.
Allow me to share the best way to overcome fear.
W-What is it...?
The most effective way to overcome fear is...

...to overpower it with an even greater fear.
Ever heard of the threshold effect?

...Found you at last, Hari.
You weren't in any of the classrooms, so this is where you were hiding.
W-Well, you see, there are deep and profound circumstances here...
I'm sure there are. Considering you abandoned your lectures, student advising, and faculty meetings to flee all the way out here, they must be truly extraordinary circumstances, wouldn't you say?

Ah, ugh...
U-Um... you see...
Yes?
Eep...
Are you... mad at me by any chance?
Why on earth are you asking the obvious, you slacker teacher?!
Waaaaah!
A moment later.

...I'll help too.
I mean... please allow me to help...
Yeah, that's the spirit.
You sold me out, didn't you...?

Sold you out? How hurtful.
Call it a strategic transaction.
I had to report you to your colleague so the pressure would make you actually do your job properly.

Thank you for reporting her.
Um, may I have your name...?

I'm <:player>.
I work as a fixer in Humanitas.

Ah, I have heard plenty of rumors about you.
It is a pleasure to meet you.
I am Jia—a colleague of this slacker teacher.

Today's classes have already passed, so there is nothing we can do about that...
but having her do community service like this will at least save face for the Hundred Schools of Thought.
Please, work her to the bone and discipline her so she can at least pull her own weight.
Oho...
Right! I'll make sure to thoroughly engrave the spirit of service and responsibility into her very body!
...You demon, monster, pervert, cold-blooded beast without a shred of pity...!
Haha, you don't need to flatter me that much.
It's not a compliment!!
Still, you're not scared of the aberrant spirits anymore, right?
Well, of course, after going through something this horrifying, aberrant spirits seem like a walk in the park!

Sob... I will definitely get my revenge!
If I can't do it in this life, I'll do it from beyond the grave!
People barely even die in this world anyway, what kind of nonsense is that now?

Hey, Jia!
Your colleague is spouting nonsense again!

Gah! Fine, I get it, so let's just go already.
If I have to hear any more nagging, my heart is going to die...
...Huh?
...Huh?

We're going together.
You, me, us, and this one here.
Well, the aberrant spirit problem is not an issue for the Moonshadow Wardens and Fairwinds Association alone.

10110071.t: For a long time, I had walked along the boundary.

A space in between that belongs neither to this side nor that side.
Between being and nothingness, righteousness and corruption, yin and yang, life and death.
Originally, I could never mingle with people.
Though there were occasionally those who approached with goodwill...
Far more treated me like a monster before leaving.

Since when was it...
that I began rejecting people from my end instead.

Turning someone away is painful.
So, all I had to do was distance myself before turning anyone away.

The only things that never changed...
were the butterflies.
For they had been with me since my earliest memory.
Yet they were not companions who could form a true bond...
And so, the solitude continued.

The solitude was painful...
yet I could never stray from my duty as the Shrine Maiden of the Boundary.
Because I knew what would happen if I neglected that duty.

That was why I rarely left the shrine.
Only occasionally did I stop by the village to obtain necessary supplies.
The village I visited from time to time was always bustling with festivals.
I merely watched the countless people passing by with smiles.
I merely watched.
Just endlessly...
Truly a tedious life, I see.
Who...?

Just a vagabond drifting with the wind and the clouds.
No, now that I have found some work, perhaps I should change that greeting?
...If you have no business with me, don't talk to me.
Hehe, business? Of course I do.

My name is Dan Xi. A guest of the Orchid Clan...
and a warrior of the Fairwinds Association who protects the festival.
So when I see someone looking so miserable at a festival, is it not only natural to ask what their story is?
I'm not looking miserable.
Is that so? To me, it looked for all the world as though you were envying them...

I've never envied them.
Don't put words in my mouth.
Is that so? Then perhaps I was mistaken.

Still, more than anything...
it simply looks as though you aren't enjoying the festival.

Festivals...
I hate them.
...And I don't see what's so fun about that, either.

Hmm, that may well be true.
Festivals are loud and bustling, after all.

Exactly.
So...
But how can you know until you've tried it yourself?

I have wandered the world for a very long time...
yet there is still much I do not know.

So isn't it a bit too early...
for you to jump to conclusions?
Heh, though I must admit, someone said those very words to me not too long ago.

Surely you have your reasons for keeping people at a distance.
Just as you tried to push me away.
How do you know that?
...Because I used to be the same way.

I spent a long time wandering.
Going wherever my feet took me, following wherever my heart led.

At first, it was delightful.
For I believed every breathtaking sight in the world belonged to me.
New bonds, unseen landscapes, festivals experienced for the very first time.
I thought I could live like that forever.

But...
that only went so far.
Only... so far...?

Yes. At some point...
that alone could no longer satisfy me.
Like a thirst that could never, ever be quenched...
...Why?

Heh, it took me a long time to find the answer...
yet it was far simpler than I had imagined.
Well, I simply grew too fond of it all.
Fond of what?
Everything. Every single thing.
The countless bonds forged during my travels, the memories of joyful times, the thrill of overcoming troubles together.

As those things piled up one by one...
there came a point where I could no longer just pass them by.
There were people I longed to see again, and places I yearned to revisit.
When others were in trouble, I wanted to help, and when there was joy, I wanted to share their laughter.
And not long ago, someone pointed it out to me.

Love...
the world?
Indeed. This world, its sights, its people, and even bustling festivals like this.

Things I once would have thought nothing of leaving behind...
had become precious to me.

And so my steps slowed...
until before I knew it, I had come to a halt.

And that's why...
you stayed?
Well, I still live half as a wanderer, I suppose.

Heh, funny, isn't it?
I thought I would live as an eternal nomad, yet here I am, finding a place to belong.
...Still, I...
I know, "Child of the Boundary."

The friend who told me...
I heard it from a companion of the Quartet.
That there is a kind child whose body and soul dwell upon the boundary.

I'm not...
kind.

Heh, did I not tell you?
Do not be so quick to make up your mind.
How about this, then?

Let us find out.
Whether you truly are kind or not. Whether you really hate festivals or love them.

What it is you truly desire.
And what you dislike, or what you hold dear...
How do we find that out?

It is quite simple.
By diving right in.
Starting with the festival you claim to hate.
...I don't want to.
Haha. I would rather hear your verdict after you have given it a try.

Who knows? Once you throw yourself into it like I did...
you might just encounter someone truly wonderful.
A bond that will lead you to new horizons, and help you discover who you truly are.
As if something like that could exist...

Good grief.
Did I not say to stop making up your mind so quickly?

Come now, what will you do? I have said all I can.
In the end, the choice is yours.
I don't know.
But...
Just watching from afar is even worse.

Heheh, fair enough.
Then let us go together and see.

But...
if it's boring, I'm leaving right away.

Of course. Allow this festival expert to teach you all there is to know!
Hehehe...

Rather than wasting time stressing over that, I'd just grab both!

W-What! What's with those looks?!

Phew... Well, yes.

...?

Eek...!

...?

I-It is nothing, my friend!
Phew...

Regardless... this will require a bit of preparation.
Kouchou, please come over here!

W-Wait... Is this... Are these... clothes...?

Put this like so... and then like this...

Eek?! N-Not there...!
This leaves everything completely exposed...!
...What's going on? Just what on earth is happening in there?
Mmm... Considering the sorcery Yomi practices, I suspect...
Phew, all ready!

Kouchou? Come on out!
Everyone is waiting, you know!
Hey, THAT'S what you meant by preparation?!

Ahaha! Do you like it?
It's my proudest masterpiece!
Of course, since it's a custom-made piece, the price would normally be just a wee bit steep!

Well, you see...!
...Whoa. That's insane.

This is... astounding.

Of course, getting my creations into the hands of the right owner matters much more to me than money!
To celebrate meeting <:player> for the first time today... I won't charge anything extra for this outfit either!
...Thanks... I guess?
Why have you been staring at me like that since earlier?
Hehehe... Think nothing of it!
Anyway... now that I've unveiled my proudest masterpiece, it's time to move on to the next step!
And that would be...
Hyaaap!
Whoa?!

10110090.t:

Yes. The power I held before receiving the power of the Red Butterfly—the power to guide and purify souls...
...The ability to attract 'corruption' and make it my own power.
Ever since long ago... my body has naturally attracted Aberrant Spirits.

Perhaps because I lived in the rift of the boundary, a place brimming with the corrupt energy of 'the other side'...
my very nature fundamentally resembles theirs.
Because of that, the people around me always end up getting hurt.

So that I wouldn't hurt anyone else, and...
so that I wouldn't get hurt myself.
If I get close to you, I will surely end up hurting you, too.
And I don't want that.

...I will seal it away.

...The power of a demon that opens Rifts and severs boundaries.

drifting alone in the void...

all the memories and moments built up until now...

...You know that, and you're STILL going to give up?!

...If it means I won't lose the people precious to me anymore.

will you... talk to me again?

W-What...?

Spouting all that useless nonsense just to mess with my head!

Hey, you only get thoughts like that because your mind is so drab and colorless!
Repaint the damn place with some color already!
I-I could do that, but...
Do it now! Right this second!
It's so gloomy in here that I can't even get in the mood to give you a piece of my mind!
Good, now this is at least bearable to look at.
I've been listening to you drone on about sealing this and giving up that...
You think I came all the way out here just to listen to that crap?

...I told you.
